responsibility: Implements expression and declaration throwability analysis used by `nothrow` checking and control-flow diagnostics. It walks expressions postorder to detect potentially throwing calls, constructors, deletes, postblits, and declaration initializers, distinguishes typed `nothrow` calls from throwing ones, emits explanatory diagnostics when required, and recursively mirrors declaration initialization semantics so variables, tuples, attributes, and mixins can be classified for exception behavior.
